title: appointment.create input
description: Input for appointment.create: book a confirmed appointment in a bookable slot. Risk R3. Requires patient_ref or pre_registration_token.

slot_id.description: Bookable slot identifier returned by appointment.find_slots.

pre_registration_token.description: Pre-registration token from patient.pre_register for a new patient.

payer_type.description: Payer type, when required by hospital policy.

confirmation_token.description: Token proving explicit user confirmation bound to this exact normalized booking action.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key that makes retries of the same request safe.

governance.validated_by: dr. Ferdi Andriska, S.H., M.Kn., CMDC
